taskbar-zoom.title: Taskbar Zoom
taskbar-zoom.selectZoom.title: Select Zoom
taskbar-zoom.resetZoom.title: Reset Zoom
taskbar-zoom.zoomIn.title: Zoom In
taskbar-zoom.zoomOut.title: Zoom Out
taskbar-zoom.followZoomIn.title: Follow Zoom In
taskbar-zoom.followZoomOut.title: Follow Zoom Out
taskbar-zoom.followZoomReset.title: Follow Reset Zoom
taskbarZoom.defaultZoom.description: Default zoom percentage. Decimal values are allowed.
taskbarZoom.zoomUnit.description: Amount applied by Zoom In and Zoom Out. Decimal values are allowed.
taskbarZoom.zoomUnitType.description: How the zoom unit is applied.
Multiply the current zoom by the unit.
taskbarZoom.zoomUnitType.additive.descri: Add the unit to the current zoom percentage.
taskbarZoom.preview.description: Apply a zoom while it is highlighted, before it is confirmed.
taskbarZoom.zoomPreset.description: Percentages listed in Select Zoom. Decimal values are allowed.
taskbarZoom.zoomInLabel.description: Status bar label for Zoom In. Codicons such as $(add) are allowed.
taskbarZoom.zoomOutLabel.description: Status bar label for Zoom Out. Codicons such as $(remove) are allowed.
taskbarZoom.fontZoomResetLabel.descripti: Status bar label for Editor Font Zoom Reset.
taskbarZoom.uiDisplayOrder.description: Status bar order. @ is font zoom reset, % is the zoom percentage, + is zoom in, and - is zoom out.
taskbarZoom.configurationTarget.auto.des: Write the workspace zoom when one is set. Otherwise write the user zoom.
taskbarZoom.configurationTarget.global.d: Always write the user zoom. A workspace zoom is cleared first.
taskbarZoom.configurationTarget.workspac: Write the workspace zoom. With no folder open, write the user zoom.
